annotations.title: Compose a kit for a business nobody has composed

description: Use this when what your human is building is not one of the published Launch Kits. Say what the business has to do, in their words, and get back a kit composed from real capabilities with real prices and a real install path, plus a list of what was left out and why. Pass their creation platform and it will refuse to compose anything that platform already supplies. Pass capability ids instead of a sentence to compose exactly what you picked. It never invents a unit price for a business nobody has priced; it prices each meter and leaves the arithmetic where your human can see it.

capabilities.description: Capability ids or aliases to compose exactly, instead of matching on the sentence.

intent.description: What the business has to do, in your human's own words.

platform.description: The creation platform their application came from.
